dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Do you also buy big things online, like furniture?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈbaɪ ˈbɪɡ ˈθɪŋz ˌɑːnˈlaɪn, laɪk ˈfɜːrnɪtʃər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Last month, I bought a desk and two chairs for my room.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ, aɪ ˈbɔːt ə ˈdɛsk ənd ˈtuː ˈtʃɛrz fər maɪ ˈruːm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: How did you choose? There's so much information online.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ dɪd juː ˈtʃuːz? ðɛrz ˈsoʊ ˈmʌtʃ ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən ˌɑːnˈlaɪn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I read reviews. They give you a lot of useful information.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈriːd rɪˈvjuːz. ðeɪ ˈɡɪv juː ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈjuːsfəl ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mostly. But my dad gave me a good piece of advice: never trust the five-star ones!
dialogue.reading: ˈmoʊstli. bʌt maɪ ˈdæd ˈɡeɪv miː ə ˈɡʊd ˈpiːs əv ədˈvaɪs: ˈnɛvər ˈtrʌst ðə ˌfaɪv ˈstɑːr ˈwʌnz!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ha! That's smart. What about luggage? Do you buy it online, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ðæts ˈsmɑːrt. ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈlʌɡɪdʒ? duː juː ˈbaɪ ɪt ˌɑːnˈlaɪn, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I buy luggage in stores. I want to touch it first.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈbaɪ ˈlʌɡɪdʒ ɪn ˈstɔːrz. aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈtʌtʃ ɪt ˈfɜːrst.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And what do you think about goods from other countries?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt duː juː ˈθɪŋk əˈbaʊt ˈɡʊdz frəm ˈʌðər ˈkʌntriz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Some are great, but delivery takes a long time. And now gasoline is so expensive that delivery costs more.
dialogue.reading: sʌm ər ˈɡreɪt, bʌt dɪˈlɪvəri ˈteɪks ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtaɪm. ənd ˈnaʊ ˈɡæsəliːn ɪz ˈsoʊ ɪkˈspɛnsɪv ðæt dɪˈlɪvəri ˈkɔːsts ˈmɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: True. Well, your knowledge of online shopping is very useful for our research. Thank you!
dialogue.reading: ˈtruː. ˈwɛl, jʊr ˈnɑːlɪdʒ əv ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ˈʃɑːpɪŋ ɪz ˈvɛri ˈjuːsfəl fər aʊər ˈriːsɜːrtʃ. ˈθæŋk juː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You're welcome! But I buy too much stuff online. My room is full of boxes!
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈwɛlkəm! bʌt aɪ ˈbaɪ ˈtuː ˈmʌtʃ ˈstʌf ˌɑːnˈlaɪn. maɪ ˈruːm ɪz ˈfʊl əv ˈbɑːksɪz!
